messages:
maria (Marketing): Hey team — I pushed an early draft of the product launch blog to Google Drive: https://drive.redwood/release-draft. Need quick alignment on three things before we hand to comms: 1) primary audience hooks (startup PMs vs infra teams), 2) pricing/benchmark claim language (we need a safe headline), and 3) inbound routing for the webinar CTA. Can folks skim and call out blockers? :pray:

devon (Product): Reading now. My high-level: lean into latency/cost benchmarks for infra teams, but add a short TL;DR for PMs that focuses on shipping speed and integration. Two separate lead flows might make sense.

ajay (Growth): +1 on two flows. For HubSpot mapping I propose: 1) 'Launch interest - PM' form => list_launch_pm, 2) 'Launch interest - Infra' form => list_launch_infra. We can auto-tag via hidden fields. I'll paste the quick mapping below.

sam (Design): Fwiw the hero visual needs to change if we call out infra benchmarks vs product velocity. I can make two hero variants and we can A/B in the header CTA routing.

eli (Legal): Quick FYI — avoid absolute language like "cheapest" or "lowest latency" without a direct benchmark citation. If we reference numbers, cite the benchmark suite and date. Also call out that Dedicated/Private variants may differ.

maria (Marketing): Thanks. ajay can you drop the HubSpot snippet? devon can you suggest the PM TL;DR paragraph (2-3 lines) and the specific benchmark copy we can use? eli we'll flag any claims that need citations.

ajay (Growth): Here is the HubSpot hidden-field mapping we can reuse: ```html
<form action="https://forms.hubspot.com/submit/12345">
  <input type="hidden" name="lead_source" value="launch-blog-2026">
  <input type="hidden" name="audience_segment" value="__SEGMENT__"> <!-- replace with PM or INFRA -->
  <input name="email" type="email"/>
  <button type="submit">Save my seat</button>
</form>
```
Replace __SEGMENT__ via the CTA route (URL param or button). I recommend endpoint params: `?seg=pm` vs `?seg=infra` so we don't create multiple forms.

maria (Marketing): Nice — that keeps one form. For routing rules: if seg=pm -> add to list_launch_pm + send PM nurture sequence; seg=infra -> add to list_launch_infra + send infra benchmark whitepaper. ajay can you add the exact workflow IDs?

ajay (Growth): Workflow IDs: PM = wf_7782_PM_launch; Infra = wf_7782_INFRA_launch. I'll set immediate tag + 24h nurture email. Also recommend tag: "launch_2026_a" for cohorting.

devon (Product): Draft PM TL;DR option: "Ship LLM features faster — Redwood removes serving friction so your product team ships production-ready prompts, routing, and monitoring in days, not months." For benchmark line (infra): "On common production workloads Redwood reduces per-token latency by up to 25% vs baseline and lowers per-request GPU cost by up to 30% (internal benchmark, May 2026)." Eli — is that okay?

eli (Legal): "Up to" claims are acceptable if backed by a benchmark doc in the repo and dated. Please link the benchmark doc in the blog and include a short methodology note: model family, seq len, infra used. Also change "vs baseline" to a named baseline (e.g., "vs standard A100 baseline") or we need to be explicit.

maria (Marketing): Good call. Devon — can you update to: "reduces per-token latency by up to 25% vs standard A100 baseline and lowers per-request GPU cost by up to 30% (see benchmark methodology: link)" ?

devon (Product): Done in the doc. Also added a short "How we tested" box.

sam (Design): Quick note on webinar CTA: we only have 250 seats. ajay — can you wire up a capacity check so the CTA switches to "Join waitlist" at 230 registrations?

ajay (Growth): Yup — launch-bot can ping when hits thresholds. I can set the cutoff and swap copy via the CMS.

launch-bot: Threshold config applied: seat_threshold=230, hard_cap=250. Will post updates to #marketing when counts reach 200, 230, 250.

maria (Marketing): Perfect. Eli — any final redlines on the pricing/benchmark copy?

eli (Legal): As long as you add the benchmark link and rename baseline to "standard A100 baseline (see methodology)", we're good. Also remove any phrasing that implies guaranteed savings for all customers. Add a short disclaimer line under the claim.

maria (Marketing): Got it. I'll add: "Results from internal benchmarks; your mileage may vary depending on workload and deployment mode."

sam (Design): I'll upload two hero variants and a small header CTA that swaps based on URL param. ETA 3 hours.

devon (Product): Last ask — can we include a small table in the blog that maps feature -> target buyer? Helps with segmentation. Suggest: "Observability & rollouts" -> PMs, "Dedicated capacity" -> infra/platform teams, "Private deployments" -> regulated enterprises.

maria (Marketing): Love that. I'll fold everything and re-upload the draft by EOD. If no major blockers, we push to comms for copy lock tomorrow morning. :rocket:
